name: scrawl
description: Scrape pages to Markdown or JSON, map sites, crawl into versioned datasets, extract with a schema, ask cited questions and download files with Scrawl, over its MCP server or the scrawl CLI.

api_key.title: Scrawl API key
api_key.description: Your ApexAPI key from the operator of your Scrawl server. Sent only as the Authorization: Bearer header to the MCP URL below, and kept in Claude Code's secure storage, not in settings.json.

mcp_url.title: Scrawl MCP URL
mcp_url.description: The Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint of your Scrawl server, ending in /mcp. Use https:// for any host that is not this machine. Default: a self-hosted server on this machine.

base_url.title: Scrawl API base URL
base_url.description: The ApexAPI base URL of the same server, used by the scrawl CLI as SCRAWL_BASE_URL. Default: a self-hosted server on this machine.
